destinationCards.title: Mangroves & Magic Lake
destinationCards.text: Discover unique mangrove forests, natural salt lakes and geological formations found only in a few places around the world.

destinationCards.title: Easy Half-Day Adventure
destinationCards.text: Enjoy a relaxed half-day trip combining nature, snorkelling and some of the best coastal scenery in South Sinai.

goodToKnow.title: National Park Entry Included
goodToKnow.text: No additional entrance fees are required.

goodToKnow.title: Snorkelling Equipment Available
goodToKnow.text: You can bring your own equipment or rent everything you need on site.

goodToKnow.title: Family-Friendly Experience
goodToKnow.text: Suitable for beginners, families and anyone who wants to discover the natural beauty of Ras Mohamed.

cta.line1: Mangroves · Snorkelling · Wishing Lake · Gate of Allah

bento.priceText: Transfer, lunch and entrance tickets already included. No prepayment.
